name: SEC EDGAR
tagline: Official US SEC filings and company facts APIs for 10-K/10-Q, XBRL, and insider data
description: Public REST APIs from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that expose EDGAR filing metadata, full-text search, company submissions, XBRL company facts, and related market data. No API key is required; callers must identify themselves with a descriptive User-Agent and respect fair-access rate limits.

auth.details: No API key or OAuth. Requests must include a descriptive User-Agent identifying the application and a contact email (e.g. SampleCompany name@samplecompany.com). Undeclared or blocked User-Agents may be denied.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public data; fair access ~10 requests/second

rate_limits: Fair access: max 10 requests per second across data.sec.gov and related EDGAR hosts; higher rates risk temporary blocks
use_cases: fetch a company's recent SEC form filings by CIK
look up XBRL company facts and financial tags for a filer
get company submissions history and filing metadata
search EDGAR full-text for keywords in filings
retrieve insider transaction (Form 4) related filing lists
